key.name: position-x
key.description: Last saved horizontal coordinate of the pet on screen (-1 for default bottom-right).

key.name: position-y
key.description: Last saved vertical coordinate of the pet on screen (-1 for default bottom-right).

key.name: animation-enabled
key.description: Whether pet idle and state animations are running.

key.name: pet-visible
key.description: Whether the pet actor is visible on the desktop.

key.name: pet-size
key.description: Pixel dimension of the pet sprite.

key.name: screen-margin
key.description: Minimum distance from monitor boundaries in pixels.

key.name: pet-state
key.description: Current status state (IDLE, WORKING, COMPLETED, ERROR, WAITING).
